subject.title: [MiniMax] M3 native video input support with timestamp-scaling metadata hint (reference branch only)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor MiniMax M3 native video input as part of the bundled MiniMax/provider runtime, or keep this only as reference material under the broader direct-video design work?
rationale: The remaining choice crosses provider API contracts, raw video egress/security policy, content-block/session semantics, and prompt calibration behavior; that is maintainer product direction rather than a safe automated bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor a split design
options.body: Use this issue as MiniMax-specific evidence, land core/generic video seams under the broader direct-video work, and add MiniMax video support only after security and live-provider proof are clear.

options.title: Keep reference only
options.body: Leave this open as reference material and do not implement MiniMax native video until broader direct-video support is prioritized.

options.title: Defer to external plugin
options.body: Ask for a MiniMax-specific plugin experiment only if maintainers decide current plugin APIs are sufficient and no core video content-block seam is needed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a split design
recommendation.body: Use this issue as MiniMax-specific evidence, land core/generic video seams under the broader direct-video work, and add MiniMax video support only after security and live-provider proof are clear.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged MiniMax M3 support PR that established the current provider/catalog/docs surface.
